title: Yemen Government Forces Widen Offensive Against Houthis Across Multiple Fronts
detail: Yemen government forces have expanded their offensive operations against Houthi forces across multiple fronts, with reports detailing the widening campaign. The escalation marks a significant intensification of fighting as coalition-backed forces press forward on multiple axes simultaneously.

media.caption: Yemen government forces expand offensive operations against Houthis across multiple fronts

title: France Deploys Military Assets to Protect Saudi Oil Infrastructure from Houthi Attacks
detail: France deployed military assets to protect Saudi Arabian oil infrastructure as Houthi attacks intensified. The French defense minister described the deployment as 'strictly defensive', marking a significant expansion of Western military involvement in countering Houthi operations targeting Gulf energy facilities.

media.caption: France deploys military assets to protect Saudi oil infrastructure from Houthi attacks

title: Yemen Health Minister Warns Health System Risks Collapse in Some Areas
detail: Yemen's health minister warned that the country's health system is at risk of collapse in some areas amid continued conflict and funding shortfalls. The warning underscores the severe humanitarian toll of the ongoing conflict, with healthcare infrastructure increasingly strained by fighting and reduced international aid.

media.caption: Yemen health minister warns of health system collapse risk amid conflict and funding shortfalls

title: Saudi Coalition Airstrikes Strike Taiz Province, Houthis Claim Dozens of Casualties
detail: Houthis reported that Saudi-led coalition airstrikes struck Taiz province, claiming dozens of casualties from the attacks. The strikes represent a specific escalation in the Taiz area beyond the multi-province coalition air campaign already documented, targeting Houthi positions in one of Yemen's most contested provinces. Independent verification of casualty figures was not immediately available.
